serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: You: Huh?! Melissa?! #Annalie_Outside.face.normal Melissa: Sorry for being late. I got caught up in something. You: Don’t worry about it. Lady Annalie: It must have been something important since you didn’t even change your clothes after work. Melissa: Not really. I just don’t like being late and didn’t want to keep you two waiting. Lady Annalie: What an earnest girl~ I like it! So it wasn’t anything serious after all, probably just work stuff. I was getting worried for nothing. Lady Annalie: I’m Lady Annalie! Nice to meet you! I have a shop not far away from here. Melissa: I’m Melissa. I work at the supermarket nearby. Lady Annalie: While we were waiting for you, Anon told me all sorts of stuff about you! #Cashier.Eyes.closed #Annalie_Outside.face.suprised Melissa: I hope he didn’t tell you too much or his life might be over. #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Pervy #Cashier.Eyes.normal Lady Annalie: Oh! That girl might be crazier than I am! You: I don’t think that’s possible… Lady Annalie: Come on, Melissa! Sit next to me! I promise I will be nice to you, ehehe~ You: You sound like an old man, you know? Melissa: … Melissa sure takes her time to choose who to sit with, but I don’t think I can blame her… She was probably thinking that I would introduce her to someone more tame than Annalie. Melissa: Is this what people call ‘between a rock and a hard place’? #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Normal+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Awww Lady Annalie: How rude! I’m a completely normal girl and a functional member of society! I’m neither a rock nor a hard place! #Annalie_Outside.face.pervy Lady Annalie: Although I can imagine that Anon here could become rock hard with a little bit of love~ Melissa: … Melissa: Is it normal for people to behave like that or am I just a creep magnet? You: Well… Lady Annalie: So, what’s your decision?! Are you going to sit next to me or next to Anon? Melissa: I’m just gonna take a chair and sit at the end of the table. Lady Annalie: Oh~ No fun~ Melissa: Anon. You: Y-Yes? Melissa: After meeting your friend here, I found a new appreciation for your dorkiness. You: Thanks… Lady Annalie: Melissa~ hun, don’t be so cruel to him. I know it might not seem like it, but he’s just doing his best~ Melissa: Right. Melissa: That shop you have. Is it a sex shop, perhaps? #Annalie_Outside.face.normal Lady Annalie: Close one, but no. I was considering that option, but the truth is, deep inside, I’m a pure-hearted maiden~ Melissa: … #Annalie_Outside.face.pervy Melissa: It must be buried very deep indeed. Sadly, I have no shovel at hand to make sure it’s still there. Lady Annalie: Good one! Somehow it seems like they are a good match. Maybe it will work out after all.
